## Helper to call google directions for just one origin and destination pair
```{r}
get_google_duration <- function(origin_lat, origin_lon,
                                dest_lat, dest_lon,
                                mode = c("bicycling", "transit"),
                                departure_time = NULL,
                                api_key = Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  if (api_key == "") stop("Set GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY env var first")

  base_url <- "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/directions/json"

  if (is.null(departure_time)) {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(Sys.time())
  } else {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(as.POSIXct(departure_time, tz = "UTC"))
  }

  query_list <- list(
    origin      = sprintf("%f,%f", origin_lat, origin_lon),
    destination = sprintf("%f,%f", dest_lat, dest_lon),
    mode        = mode,
    key         = api_key
  )

  if (mode == "transit") {
    query_list$departure_time <- departure_unix
  }

  res <- GET(base_url, query = query_list)
  cont <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

  if (cont$status != "OK" || length(cont$routes) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      duration_min = NA_real_,
      route_summary = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  leg <- cont$routes[[1]]$legs[[1]]
  duration_min <- leg$duration$value / 60 

  # trying to pull line short_names (63, A Line, 3A)
  route_summary <- NA_character_
  if (mode == "transit" && "steps" %in% names(leg)) {
    steps <- leg$steps
    if (!is.null(steps$transit_details)) {
      short_names <- steps$transit_details$line$short_name
      short_names <- short_names[!is.na(short_names)]
      if (length(short_names) > 0) {
        route_summary <- paste(unique(short_names), collapse = " + ")
      }
    }
  }

  tibble(
    duration_min  = duration_min,
    route_summary = route_summary
  )
}
```

## Attaching lat/long coordinated to the trips using GTFS stops
```{r}
trip_stops_coords <- trip_stops %>%
  left_join(stops %>% select(stop_id, stop_lat, stop_lon),
            by = c("start_stop_id" = "stop_id")) %>%
  rename(start_lat = stop_lat, start_lon = stop_lon) %>%
  left_join(stops %>% select(stop_id, stop_lat, stop_lon),
            by = c("end_stop_id" = "stop_id")) %>%
  rename(end_lat = stop_lat, end_lon = stop_lon)
```

## For each trip: bike vs transit using google
```{r}
set.seed(123)
sample_trips <- trip_stops_coords %>%
  semi_join(valid_trips, by = "trip_id") %>%
  sample_n(500) %>% 
  left_join(valid_trips %>% select(trip_id, TripDuration, StartTime),
            by = "trip_id") %>%
  mutate(duration_micro_min = TripDuration / 60)
```

```{r}
get_google_duration <- function(origin_lat, origin_lon,
                                dest_lat, dest_lon,
                                mode = c("bicycling", "transit"),
                                departure_time = NULL,
                                api_key = Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY")) {

  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  base_url <- "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/directions/json"

  if (is.null(departure_time)) {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(Sys.time())
  } else {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(as.POSIXct(departure_time, tz = "UTC"))
  }

  q <- list(
    origin = sprintf("%f,%f", origin_lat, origin_lon),
    destination = sprintf("%f,%f", dest_lat, dest_lon),
    mode = mode,
    key = api_key
  )

  if (mode == "transit") {
    q$departure_time <- departure_unix
  }

  res <- GET(base_url, query = q)
  cont <- fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

  if (is.null(cont$routes) || length(cont$routes) == 0 || cont$status != "OK") {
    return(tibble(
      duration_min = NA_real_,
      route_summary = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  leg <- cont$routes[[1]]$legs[[1]]
  duration_min <- leg$duration$value / 60

  route_summary <- NA_character_
  if (mode == "transit") {
    steps <- leg$steps
    if (!is.null(steps$transit_details)) {
      short_names <- steps$transit_details$line$short_name
      if (!is.null(short_names)) {
        short_names <- short_names[!is.na(short_names)]
        if (length(short_names) > 0) {
          route_summary <- paste(unique(short_names), collapse = " + ")
        }
      }
    }
  }

  tibble(
    duration_min = duration_min,
    route_summary = route_summary
  )
}
```

## Transit vs transit with google (eg. 63 vs A+3A)
```{r}
get_transit_via <- function(o_lat, o_lon, d_lat, d_lon,
                            via_lat = NULL, via_lon = NULL,
                            departure_time = NULL) {

  base <- sprintf("%f,%f", o_lat, o_lon)
  dest <- sprintf("%f,%f", d_lat, d_lon)
  via  <- if (!is.null(via_lat)) sprintf("via:%f,%f", via_lat, via_lon) else NULL

  base_url <- "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/directions/json"

  q <- list(
    origin      = base,
    destination = dest,
    mode        = "transit",
    key         = Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY"),
    departure_time = as.integer(if (is.null(departure_time)) Sys.time()
                                else as.POSIXct(departure_time, tz = "UTC"))
  )
  if (!is.null(via)) q$waypoints <- via

  res  <- GET(base_url, query = q)
  cont <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

  if (cont$status != "OK" || length(cont$routes) == 0) {
    return(tibble(duration_min = NA_real_,
                  route_summary = NA_character_))
  }

  leg <- cont$routes[[1]]$legs[[1]]
  duration_min <- leg$duration$value / 60

  steps <- leg$steps
  short_names <- if (!is.null(steps$transit_details))
    steps$transit_details$line$short_name else NA
  short_names <- short_names[!is.na(short_names)]
  route_summary <- if (length(short_names) == 0) NA_character_
                   else paste(unique(short_names), collapse = " + ")

  tibble(duration_min = duration_min,
         route_summary = route_summary)
}
```

```{r}
option1 <- get_transit_via(o_lat, o_lon, d_lat, d_lon, departure_time = "2024-10-01 08:00")
option2 <- get_transit_via(o_lat, o_lon, d_lat, d_lon,
                           via_lat = transfer_lat, via_lon = transfer_lon,
                           departure_time = "2024-10-01 08:00")
```
